label: Main effects
subgoals: Code the factor levels as minus one and plus one
Average the responses at the high level and at the low level
Subtract the low average from the high average

label: Interactions
subgoals: Classify each run by the sign of the product of its coded levels
Average the plus-product runs and the minus-product runs
Read the interaction as half the change in one effect across the other factor

label: The fitted regression model
subgoals: Set the intercept to the grand mean
Halve each effect to get its coefficient
Evaluate the coded model at the query point
